title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Amount Applied from a Covering Remittance
content:
## Clause

A remittance that covers the charges due on a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file is applied at precisely the charges due; whatever it carries beyond that is returned by finance and is never booked. Where the charges due come to 0.00 or less, nothing is applied. Where the holder of the acceptance is not the booking party, the amount applied is 0.00 whatever the charges due. The amount is stated to two decimal places.
